notes: v2.0.2 — Notification controls + UX polish. New ongoing-call notification with Answer / Decline (when ringing) and Mute / Speaker / End call (mid-call) so the call is fully controllable from the shade; tapping the body returns to the in-call screen. Gentle call-waiting beep replaces the full ringtone when a second call comes in during another call. Default storage account for new contacts is now configurable in Settings → Tools. Speaker toggle now appears during outgoing dialing. Reply-with-message and Decline buttons swapped to keep Decline centered; new Reply with actions menu adds Reply with block (reject the call and block the caller). Dialpad input is now persisted across launches.
